title: He Knows Every Star by Name
story: He Calls the Stars by Name
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Who holds the oceans in His hand?
Who weighs the mountains tall?
Who spread the sky out like a tent
And hung it over all?

[Chorus]
He brings the stars out one by one
And calls them each by name;
Not one is lost, not one forgot,
And He knows yours the same.

[Verse 2]
Some made a statue, wood and gold,
And bowed before it low;
The workmen had to tie it tight
Or over it would go.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Lie back and count the stars with Wren,
One, two, and three, and four;
And when you lose your place, my love,
There's always, always more.

[Chorus]

[Verse 4]
So lift your eyes up high tonight
And whisper, soft and small,
"You know my name, You know my name,
The One who made them all."

[Chorus]
mood: Counting music. A slow, even pulse under the voice, one star at a time, like a child's finger moving across the sky, losing count and starting again. A small celtic harp picks out the pulse with a cello held low beneath it, and the voice stays light and close. It lifts a little with each verse, then settles on the last chorus as if the whole sky has gone quiet.
